notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {7}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
description:
Activate all mana producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {7}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Sublime Epiphany by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages.
The Scholar of the Ages token enters the battlefield, returning Turnabout and Sublime Epiphany from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
You may also select any of Sublime Epiphany's other modes.
